slide1.title: Добро пожаловать в CubicLauncher!
slide1.desc: A modern, fast Minecraft launcher. Manage multiple instances, mods, Java configurations и more. Let's take a quick tour!

slide2.title: Какой аккаунт вы хотите использовать?
slide2.desc: Выберите тип аккаунта для настройки. Позже можно добавить аккаунты или сменить активный в профиле.

accounts.later: You can also click Далее and set up your account later.

slide3.title: Ваши инстансы
slide3.desc: Instances are separate Minecraft installations. View и select your instances here. Each one can have its own version, mods и configuration.

slide4.title: Создать инстанс
slide4.desc: Use this button to create a new instance. Choose a name, version, loader (Fabric, Forge, NeoForge) и a custom icon.

slide5.title: Загрузка версий
slide5.desc: Download Minecraft versions here. Get official releases, snapshots, alphas и Fabric versions to use in your instances.

slide6.title: Настройки
slide6.desc: The Settings panel has three sections: Launcher, Minecraft и Java. Let's look at each one.

slide7.title: Разделы настроек
slide7.desc: Use the tabs to navigate between Launcher (language, themes, updates), Minecraft (RAM, versions, console) и Java (runtimes, arguments).

slide8.title: Конфигурация Java
slide8.desc: Manage Java 8, 17, 21 и 25 runtimes here. Install Java automatically from the launcher or use an existing installation. You can also configure JVM arguments и environment variables.

slide9.title: Лицензия
slide9.desc: CubicLauncher is free software released under the GNU General Public Лицензия v3.

tutorial.licenseBullet1: You are free to use, study, share и modify the software.
tutorial.licenseBullet2: При распространении ПО необходимо сохранить ту же лицензию.
